subject.title: fix(memory): respect QMD timeout for memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw land this scoped policy where an existing raised `memory.qmd.limits.timeoutMs` extends only the QMD command phase of interactive `memory_search`, after rebasing the dirty head?
rationale: The code appears technically sound and well-proven, but changing the runtime effect of an existing timeout setting can alter interactive wait behavior for upgraded users, which is a maintainer-owned compatibility and availability choice.

options.title: Rebase and land scoped QMD policy
options.body: Resolve the current main conflict while preserving the longer budget only for QMD command execution and the 15s default bounds for setup, fallback, supplemental work, visibility filtering, and cleanup.

options.title: Require separate opt-in
options.body: Ask for a revised patch if maintainers decide existing QMD command timeout settings must not lengthen interactive agent waits without a new explicit setting.

options.title: Defer to broader timeout direction
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one product decision for general `memory_search` timeout configurability instead of this narrower QMD-owned interpretation.

recommendation.title: Rebase and land scoped QMD policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the current main conflict while preserving the longer budget only for QMD command execution and the 15s default bounds for setup, fallback, supplemental work, visibility filtering, and cleanup.
